instructions: Implement only the selected Agent Strategy frontend task using design 6 and the completed sibling backend contract/code. No backend, migration, design, progress, runner/configuration or Git edits. Replace preview/automatic strategy choice with the specified guided Strategy/Games/Finalize workflow, preserving Games Refresh, current-week odds, saved team-name side labels, Pacific kickoff/final scores, creation-key recovery, exact money, history and settlement. Use persisted server progress, not simulated timers. Keep financial and execution status separate. No API keys, profile editor, model controls, direct model/search requests, eval system, comparison dashboard or new results page. Adapt affected old preview/synchronous-creation tests to the new contract without skipping required regressions. FE-05 must implement and run actual API/worker/PostgreSQL desktop/mobile acceptance, including controlled Agent research, disconnect/reopen, replay, retry/quote changes, reasoning, partial/all-failed outcomes, restart fencing and settlement. The existing browser image includes Node/Chromium and Python backend dependencies. Its --live --backend-arg=--agent-worker check starts frontend/tests/support/live_backend.py with the opt-in worker fixture prepared by BE-07, generated database metadata and standard LIVE_API/LIVE_RUN_DB_FILE/TEST_API_BASE_URL variables. Ensure new Agent live acceptance tests are enabled by that invocation and do not silently skip. No real Ollama/DuckDuckGo calls are needed; actual service smoke remains separate. The runner records progress and commits each verified task.
completion_note: Automated browser checks use controlled data. FE-05 additionally requires real API/worker execution in a generated disposable PostgreSQL database with fake model/search responses. Actual Ollama/DuckDuckGo behavior is not established by these checks.
